name: (99942) Apophis
verdict_text: Clearly seen in SPHEREx photos, right where its orbit predicts.

story.by: R. Tucker, D. Tholen, F. Bernardi
story.plain: Found in 2004 and briefly the most worrying asteroid known. Older photos from before its discovery ruled out an impact. It will pass very close to Earth on 13 April 2029.

cloud.note: Sample: clones drawn from made-up uncertainties around the real orbit. after = with the Rewind positions added; null if nothing measured.

quiz.answer_text: Yes. The dot in the middle is the asteroid, exactly where its orbit says it should be.
